ge.wd1: English expat comedy and language-exchange karaoke on Thursday, plus Mondial de l'Impro qualifiers at the BFM.
ge.we1: Festival du Soir at Palexpo with GIMS, the Mondial de l'Impro final, letterpress and Ikebana workshops; rain likely, so plan indoors.
ge.wd2: Embroidery on Monday, English comedy on Tuesday, a language exchange on Wednesday and a Halloween paint night on Thursday.
ge.we2: GIFF film festival opens, Halloween parties everywhere, Onex's 175th birthday fête and a philosophy café in English on Saturday.

zh.wd1: English stand-up at Comedy Brew and a free arcade night with Zurich Together on Thursday.
zh.we1: Basel's Herbstmesse opens, Bürkliplatz flea market and portrait and sculpture-drawing workshops; rain likely, so indoor plans win.
zh.wd2: Speed friending on Tuesday, a pub quiz on Wednesday and the Expovina wine ships opening on Thursday.
zh.we2: Last Bürkliplatz flea market of the season, pumpkin carving, big expat Halloween parties and watercolours in the tropical greenhouses.

picks.why: Indoor festival village at Palexpo: GIMS live, then a huge Brazilian party; easy rain-proof night out.
Hands-on letterpress printing and bookbinding at the Palais de l'Athénée for CHF 20.
Late-night English stand-up at El Catrín; grab tacos first and make a night of it.
Cosy Ikebana workshop in an Old Town café, in English; a calm indoor Sunday.
Free embroidery workshop at Pavillon bleu in Les Grottes; relaxed and easy to chat.
Free English comedy night in the Old Town where pros test new material.
Free language exchange at Halle de l'Ile: the easiest way to meet new people midweek.
Paint, drink and meet people at a Halloween-themed session; no art skills needed.
Portrait sketching workshop with an artist; a creative, indoor afternoon.
Opening day of Basel's huge autumn fair: rides, mulled wine and a crafts village, 55 min away.
Speed friending at a daytime rave: coffee, croissants and new friends in Enge.
Draw from ancient sculptures in the university's archaeology collection; great indoor practice.
Free speed friending at SOHO: meet lots of people quickly in a friendly setting.
Free, lively pub quiz in the city centre; join a team on the night.
Opening night of the wine ships at Bürkliplatz; taste wines with friends after work.
Weekly English open-mic comedy at ROBIN's Coffee; CHF 5 and a friendly crowd.

edits.a-ge-language-exchange-geneva-10-28: Free language exchange at Halle de l'Ile: tables by language, a relaxed crowd and an easy way to meet new people.
edits.a-zh-speed-friending-day-rave-10-24: Speed friending at a daytime rave in Enge: quick rounds of chat over coffee and croissants, then dance. Free, but get a ticket via social-circle.ch.
edits.a-ge-drink-paint-and-meet-spooky-hallowe: A Halloween-themed paint-and-drink evening at Lucha Libre: paint a spooky canvas, have a drink and meet new people. All materials included.
edits.a-zh-portrait-sketches-workshop-10-24: Portrait sketching workshop with artist Proximus Mustafa, focused on presence and self-expression; beginners welcome.
edits.a-zh-figu-rliches-zeichnen-von-antiken-s: Figure-drawing session among ancient sculptures in the University of Zurich's archaeology collection, practising proportion, movement and perspective.
edits.a-ge-122-atelier-croquez-monsieur-madame: Life-drawing afternoon with two models at Quai du Seujet, with poses from short sketches to long studies; all levels welcome.
edits.a-ge-atelier-pictura-espace-du-quartier-: Evening life-drawing session with a model at the Saint-Jean community space, 18:30–20:30; bring your own materials.
edits.a-ge-sketchcrawl-cimetiere-des-rois-10-3: Group sketching walk through the leafy Cimetière des Rois in Plainpalais; bring a sketchbook and join in at any level.
edits.a-zh-zu-rich-mosaiklampen-herstellungs-w: Make your own Turkish mosaic lamp in a hands-on workshop in Kreis 3; all materials provided and you take the lamp home.
edits.a-ge-paint-flirt-ceramic-edition-by-soci: Ceramic-painting social evening for ages 22–35 at Ceramic KANVAS. Free, but get a ticket via social-circle.ch.
edits.a-ge-32e-mondial-de-l-impro-finale-10-24: The final of the World Amateur Improv Championship at the BFM, after nine days of heats between French-speaking teams (in French).
edits.a-ge-les-puces-de-nyon-quartier-de-rive-: Nyon's monthly flea market on the lakeside Rue de Rive, with antiques, vintage and bric-a-brac; a lovely day trip with the dog.
edits.a-zh-tropical-watercolors-11-01: Paint watercolours from life inside the warm tropical greenhouses of the University Botanical Garden; a cosy creative afternoon.
edits.a-ge-atelier-broderie-x-renc-art-10-26: Free embroidery workshop with Cosmina D. at Pavillon bleu in Les Grottes, exploring embroidery as a way of telling stories.

add.trip: Geneva · bus 5/10 or train to Genève-Aéroport
add.when: 16 Oct – 1 Nov · Fri & Sat nights from 19:00
add.title: Festival du Soir — 10th edition at Palexpo
add.desc: Geneva's big indoor night festival takes over Palexpo for three weekends: each Friday and Saturday has its own world, from electronic music and circus to Latin parties, disco revival and a giant Halloween. Open the festival for the night-by-night programme.

add.trip: Geneva · bus 5/10 or train to Genève-Aéroport
add.title: GIMS + Triangle des Bermudes, then Baile do Village XXL
add.desc: Festival du Soir night: French rap-pop star GIMS on the main stage until midnight, then a big Brazilian-Latin party (Baile do Village XXL) on the second stage. One ticket for both.

add.trip: Geneva · bus 5/10 or train to Genève-Aéroport
add.title: Nostalgia & Disco Party XXL + La Troya
add.desc: Festival du Soir night: 80s–2000s nostalgia with live sets from Gala, Boney M. and O-Zone on the main stage, plus La Troya, the Ibiza party, on the second stage.

add.trip: Geneva · bus 5/10 or train to Genève-Aéroport
add.title: Positiv — Paul Kalkbrenner, Mind Against
add.desc: Festival du Soir techno night with Paul Kalkbrenner, Mind Against, Nicolas Cuer and La Forêt.

add.trip: Geneva · bus 5/10 or train to Genève-Aéroport
add.title: Megalloween — 20th anniversary + Día de los Muertos
add.desc: Festival du Soir's giant Halloween party in costume, with a Día de los Muertos festival running alongside.

add.title: GIFF — Geneva International Film Festival (32nd edition)
add.place: Théâtre Pitoëff and venues around town, Rue de Carouge 52, Geneva
add.desc: Ten days of films, series and immersive/VR experiences, with talks and big GIFF Night parties; many screenings are in English or subtitled.

add.title: Les Automnales — Geneva's autumn fair
add.desc: Geneva's big ten-day autumn fair: a food festival with bars and food trucks, the Arvinis wine fair, a shopping market and an upcycling area; open late on Fri and Sat.

add.title: Expovina — wine ships on Lake Zurich
add.desc: A Zurich classic: ships moored at Bürkliplatz become a floating wine fair with thousands of wines to taste; a fun after-work outing with friends.

add.title: Basler Herbstmesse — 555th Basel autumn fair
add.place: Barfüsserplatz, Münsterplatz, Petersplatz and more, Basel
add.desc: Switzerland's oldest and biggest funfair spreads over seven squares in Basel, with rides, mulled wine, roasted chestnuts and a crafts village and market at Petersplatz.

add.title: Bürkliplatz flea market
add.desc: Zurich's best-loved Saturday flea market by the lake: vintage, antiques, books and curiosities; the season ends on 31 October.

add.title: Bürkliplatz flea market — last market of the season
add.desc: Final Saturday of the season at Zurich's big lakeside flea market: vintage, antiques, books and curiosities.

add.title: Rosenhof crafts market in the Niederdorf
add.desc: Small Saturday market of local makers and artisans (jewellery, ceramics, textiles) on a pretty square in the Old Town.
